claim: Try it with sample data; demo settings stay separate and Reset demo removes them.

sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo/; save a sample pronunciation, assert only the demo namespace is used, then reset it

claim: The demo reads a selection or current line and applies a personal pronunciation.
sandbox: fresh demo; select an identifier, set its pronunciation, then collapse the selection and verify current-line output

claim: Demo code stays in the browser.
sandbox: record every request while editing and listening to sample code; assert every request is same-origin

claim: The reader turns braces, operators, indentation, camel case, and snake case into distinct speech.
where: landing how-it-works section, extension descriptions, README
sandbox: shared reader fixture containing nested indentation, braces, a multi-character operator, camel case, and snake case

claim: The reader prefers an English voice marked local by the browser.
sandbox: voice fixture with a network English voice and a local English voice; assert the local voice is selected

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
where: landing facts and demo offline notice
sandbox: load /demo/, wait for service-worker control, then disable network and reload the demo
